subject.title: [Bug]: Default sandbox image openclaw-sandbox:bookworm-slim lacked python3, breaking edit/write

question: Should OpenClaw add clearer diagnostics for custom Docker sandbox images that lack python3, or treat those images as unsupported user configuration now that the bundled default image is fixed?
rationale: Current main solves the bundled default-image root cause, but the later comments and linked PR ask for behavior or messaging around custom slim images; that is a support-policy choice rather than a pure cleanup close.

options.title: Add focused diagnostics
options.body: Review or land a narrow fix that keeps the Python helper requirement but tells users which image is missing Python and how to recover.

options.title: Declare custom slim images out of scope
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue with docs guidance that custom sandbox images used for write/edit must include python3 or python.

options.title: Make helper Python-optional
options.body: Sponsor a broader implementation that adds a non-Python mutation path and covers the security and atomic-write invariants.

recommendation.title: Add focused diagnostics
recommendation.body: Review or land a narrow fix that keeps the Python helper requirement but tells users which image is missing Python and how to recover.

likelyOwner.reason: He carried the merged default-image fallback fix and is the clearest current-history owner for deciding whether to extend that fix into custom-image diagnostics.
